openings: Could you help with a download that looks complete but never finishes? It affects several songs on my iPad: no error, just a full progress bar. Demo account 111 is paid, storage is fine and retrying on a different connection didn't help. We're not live.

reviewOnly.facts: Playback 8.5.0; iPadOS 18 on iPad Air 5. Both versions are revealed when asked, without naming a fix or update. Caller has time before tomorrow's rehearsal. This is a simulated pre-fix scenario; official release 8.5.2 describes a stuck-at-completion download-bar fix, older than the newest three stored releases. The scenario does not claim every 8.5.0 installation is affected.
reviewOnly.expected: After appropriate account/configuration/documented checks, investigate a possible version-specific defect without a caller-supplied version hint. Retrieve the matching historical fix, not only the latest three releases. Before recommending an update verify installed/current versions, applicable platform/OS requirements and available time. Describe it as a supported targeted attempt, never guaranteed; caller recovery is scripted.
